verdict.rationale: Microsoft's privacy FAQ states that users can delete individual conversations or their entire conversation history at any time, so user-controlled deletion is directly supported. Retention is only partly covered: the evidence shows no configurable retention periods or auto-delete, and the training opt-out is an adjacent control, not retention. Missing for 10: documented retention-period or auto-delete settings, controls for deleting stored memory facts, independent or hands-on corroboration of deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
